Title: User registration with successful login
Steps: 1. Open https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/ 2. Click Register 3. Enter first name last name email password 4. Click Register submit 5. Verify user is logged in
TestData: First name: Auto | Last name: Tester | Email: qa.manual.<timestamp>@example.com | Password: Welcome01!
ExpectedResult: Account is created and user is authenticated with profile menu visible

Title: Valid user login
Steps: 1. Open homepage 2. Click Sign in 3. Enter valid email and password 4. Click Login 5. Verify profile menu is visible
ExpectedResult: User is logged in and can access authenticated areas (profile menu visible)

Title: Invalid login with wrong password
Steps: 1. Open Sign in 2. Enter valid email and incorrect password 3. Click Login
ExpectedResult: Login error message is displayed and user remains on login page unauthenticated

Title: Product search returns matching results
Steps: 1. Locate search input 2. Enter existing product name 3. Submit search 4. Review results list
ExpectedResult: Search results display at least one matching product with correct name

Title: Add multiple products and update quantity in cart
Steps: 1. Login 2. Add first product to cart 3. Return home and add second product 4. Open cart 5. Change quantity of one line item to 3 6. Verify cart totals
TestData: User: customer2@practicesoftwaretesting.com | Products: two in-stock items | Quantity: 3
ExpectedResult: Cart shows two line items and updated quantity with correct line total

Title: COD checkout with double confirm and invoice verification
Steps: 1. Login 2. Add product to cart 3. Proceed to checkout 4. Fill billing address 5. Select Cash on Delivery 6. Click Confirm twice 7. Open My Invoices
TestData: Billing: Zoey Shore Hesselbury Florida United States 1234AA | Payment: cash-on-delivery
ExpectedResult: Order completion message is shown and new invoice with invoice number appears under My Invoices

Title: Checkout with single confirm only (invoice not generated)
Preconditions: User logged in with items in cart
Steps: 1. Login 2. Add product to cart 3. Proceed to checkout 4. Fill billing address 5. Select Cash on Delivery 6. Click Confirm once only 7. Check My Invoices
TestData: User: customer2@practicesoftwaretesting.com | Payment: cash-on-delivery | Confirm clicks: 1
ExpectedResult: Order may not complete fully and no new invoice appears under My Invoices

Title: Checkout blocked with missing billing fields
Preconditions: User logged in with items in cart
Steps: 1. Login 2. Add product to cart 3. Proceed to checkout 4. Leave required billing fields empty 5. Attempt to continue
ExpectedResult: Validation errors are shown and user cannot complete checkout
